name: Zebulun
summary: Jacob's sixth son by Leah. Jacob said Zebulun would live by the sea and be a haven for ships.

key_moments.title: Born to Leah
key_moments.description: Leah bore Jacob a sixth son and said God had given her a good dowry, and now her husband would dwell with her. She named him Zebulun.

key_moments.title: Goes Down to Egypt
key_moments.description: Zebulun went down to Egypt with his father Jacob and the whole family, along with his sons.

key_moments.title: Blessed by Jacob
key_moments.description: Jacob said Zebulun would live at the haven of the sea and be a haven for ships, with his border reaching to Zidon.
